task.description: WF-03 Step 1: diagnose current reproduction state of ISS-0101 (shadow tenant_default.tenant + OutOfOrderMigration). Verify via: (1) psql query for tenant table in all schemas, (2) column drift check, (3) zig build migrate exit code, (4) migrations.zig out-of-order logic review.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm whether tenant_default.tenant shadow still exists
Confirm whether zig build migrate reports OutOfOrderMigration
Classify each sub-defect as OPEN/RESOLVED and explain why
Identify why prior GBL-139 fix did not eliminate the shadow

result.summary: Diagnosis complete. See issues[] for full breakdown. Defect 1 (shadow table) STILL OPEN. Defect 2 (OutOfOrderMigration) RESOLVED by ISS-0603/GBL-133. Root cause of persistence: 031 still runs all_schemas (no scope: public header); GBL-139 DROP skipped due to FK chain (tenant_hostnames -> tenant); both shadows re-resurrected post-GBL-139 by accidental tenant_default reprovision during WF03-GH566-20260808.

issues.description: STILL OPEN — tenant_default.tenant shadow table exists with 5 rows and schema drift (missing tenant_type, production_tenant_id columns vs public.tenant). tenant_default.tenant_hostnames also exists as shadow (FK: tenant_hostnames.tenant_id -> tenant_default.tenant). Root cause: migrations/031_adp04b_tenant_realm_binding.sql has no -- scope: public header, so it runs in all_schemas scope and CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant executes in the tenant_default pass, creating the shadow on every fresh provision.
evidence: docker exec r-co-db_test-1 psql ... SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name=tenant: returns public|tenant AND tenant_default|tenant
Column diff: tenant_default.tenant missing tenant_type and production_tenant_id (added by GBL-080 and later — GBL-only, skipped in tenant passes)
zig build migrate exit=0 (warmed db — no error on warm start)
migrations/031_adp04b_tenant_realm_binding.sql line 4: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant (... — no -- scope: public header present

GBL-139 v_tables includes tenant and tenant_hostnames but DROP TABLE tenant_default.tenant RESTRICT fails: tenant_default.tenant_hostnames FK references it; tenant_hostnames was re-created AFTER GBL-139 ran (accidental tenant_default drop+reprovision during WF03-GH566-20260808 at 2026-08-08 08:19Z per GBL-138 forensics)
issues.resolution_path: Two-step fix: (a) GBL-140 migration: DROP tenant_default.tenant_hostnames first (no FK dependents), then DROP tenant_default.tenant (FK chain broken) — use existence guards + RESTRICT; (b) add -- scope: public header to migrations/031_adp04b_tenant_realm_binding.sql to prevent re-creation on future provisions. Verify public.tenant.tenant_type and production_tenant_id data is authoritative and no test reads tenant_default.tenant directly.

issues.description: RESOLVED — OutOfOrderMigration false-positive on cold-start. ISS-0603 (GH-467) replaced global max_applied_order watermark with walked_order (highest order seen in THIS run). Duplicate numbers 050_tenant_hostnames.sql and 050_xc01_trace_id_audit.sql both return migrationOrder()=50; the out-of-order check is strict less-than (50 < 50 = false), so same-order pairs never trigger it. GBL-133 reconciles the ledger for all 97 migration files. zig build migrate exits 0 on current warmed db_test confirming no regression.
evidence: src/db/migrations.zig line 398: return MigrationError.OutOfOrderMigration only when file_order < walked_order (strict less-than)
zig build migrate exit=0, all migrations show skip (already applied)
GBL-133 v_filenames lists both 050_tenant_hostnames.sql and 050_xc01_trace_id_audit.sql explicitly
issues.resolution_path: No action needed. Mark sub-defect D2 resolved in ISS-0101. Close the OutOfOrderMigration part of GH-359 in release notes.

result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER (Step 2): design GBL-140 migration (drop shadow tables in dependency order) + 031_adp04b scope fix. Verify no test reads tenant_default.tenant directly before issuing DROP.
